words.sense: choose to go without something available
misconceptions: Treating voluntary sacrifice as though someone were resisting provocation.

words.sense: hold oneself back from acting, particularly when provoked
misconceptions: Treating self-restraint under provocation as simply declining an offered benefit.

semantic_axes.description: Forego means give up an available opportunity or benefit; forbear means deliberately restrain an action or response, often under provocation.

edges.boundary_rule: Forego means give up an available opportunity or benefit; forbear means deliberately restrain an action or response, often under provocation.
clues_a: chooses not to claim a benefit

misconceptions.M1: Confuses forego with forbear by overlooking the defining difference: Forego means give up an available opportunity or benefit; forbear means deliberately restrain an action or response, often under provocation.
misconceptions.M2: Assumes evidence for forbear necessarily proves forego; these are different tests.
misconceptions.M3: Overweights a later superficial detail instead of retaining or appropriately updating the original boundary evidence.

chains.frame: Which word best describes Amira’s decision about the concert?

beats.text: Amira declined a free ticket to a concert she wanted to attend so she could study.
beats.reason: She gives up a benefit that was available to her.

beats.text: Even when another seat opened beside her friend, she stayed home.
beats.decisive_clue: continued choosing to go without the offered experience
beats.reason: A second offer confirms the sacrifice was her choice.

chains.feedback_short: Continued choosing to go without the offered experience; a second offer confirms the sacrifice was her choice.
chains.feedback_deep: Forego means choose to go without something available; forbear means hold oneself back from acting, particularly when provoked. A second offer confirms the sacrifice was her choice.
chains.contrast_rule: Forego means give up an available opportunity or benefit; forbear means deliberately restrain an action or response, often under provocation.

beats.text: When a customer mocked his mistake, Mateo pressed his lips together instead of snapping back.
beats.decisive_clue: withheld an angry response despite provocation
beats.reason: He restrains an action he is tempted to take.

beats.text: He finished serving the customer without answering the insult.
beats.decisive_clue: continued to resist replying to the insult
beats.reason: Not retaliating through the encounter makes his restraint clearer.
